title: Memphis
look: 1980s Memphis design: pastel blocks, black squiggles and confetti, a dotted belly and a striped accent.

doc.essence: A loud postmodern print: sugary pastels and black, every surface its own pattern, the background a party of squiggles, zigzags, triangles and dots thrown around at odd angles.
doc.notIt: Not crayon (printed, crisp patterns, black squiggles), not bauhaus (pastels and playful clutter, no strict primaries), not flat (patterns on every area, a busy stage).
doc.shapes: A medium black outline on every part.
doc.colour: Areas snap to pink, mint, yellow, lilac or cyan. The body stays flat; the belly gets black dots and the accent black stripes.
pitfalls: A busy stage can swallow the character: the stage stays at the edges.
Patterned areas behind the face are kept off the body.
